remarks: Well-maintained 4-bedroom bungalow in the established Wellington neighbourhood offering approximately 1,033 sq. ft. of above-grade living space. This home features 2 bathrooms, a fully finished basement, a gas fireplace, and a heated double detached garage. Accessibility features include a wheelchair ramp leading to the sundeck and a stair lift providing access to the basement. Recent updates include the sewer line, sump pump, and hot water tank. This property offers convenient access to schools, shopping, public transit, and other everyday amenities. A great opportunity for families, first-time buyers, or those looking to add their own personal touches in a desirable northwest Edmonton community. (id:67522)
